what: An issue that would take bob above his maxBalance limit.
reference: Checks maxBalance only after commit: the intent stays `committed` forever with a core.limit-exceeded proof and the credit is never applied.
ours: Checks maxBalance with the other limits before preparing and rejects the intent: failed (same reason and detail) → aborted → rejected.
why: An intent that can never reach a final status is a defect, not a contract. Clients waiting for completed/rejected would wait forever.

what: Access check for `read` on a wallet.
reference: Lists the ledger rule {action: any, record: any} and a server-level rule {action: any, record: wallet} — the public sandbox grants every caller any action on wallets of every ledger.
ours: Lists only the ledger rule. Our default server rules grant `access` and `create ledger` to authenticated signers, nothing on wallets.
why: A server-wide grant on every wallet is a sandbox convenience, not part of the API contract; copying it would make wallets world-writable. Server rules are configurable (buildApp serverRules) for anyone who wants the sandbox's behaviour.
